provided that, with respect to any litigation, arbitration or other proceeding between the Parties, nothing in this Section 5 shall prevent either Party from disclosing any facts or circumstances with respect to any such litigation, arbitration or other proceeding.
scored_examples.generated_answer: Each party covenants and agrees during the Standstill Period not to publicly disparage, impugn, make ad hominem attacks on, or otherwise defame, slander, or communicate statements that might reasonably be construed to disparage or derogate the other party or its representatives, employees, stockholders, businesses, products, or services (Section 6).
